[LSIG.5.3] `integral` is available under `realtime` for `sliding` and
`tumbling` only. The compiler must reject `integral all_time` under
`realtime` with `DS_VALIDATE_SERIES_REALTIME_UNBOUNDED_BACKING` (error — reject): the ring grows without
bound when no window limits it. The error should suggest `integral sliding W`
with a sufficiently large `W`, or a host-side build for true cumulative
totals.
